setup: Stand slightly wider than hip width, toes turned a little outward.
Brace the trunk, keep the chest up and begin with the hips moving backward.
executionSteps: Lower with the hips moving back and down while bending the knees.
Keep heels grounded and knees aligned with the second toes. End descent near parallel or earlier if heels lift or torso control changes.
Exhale as hips and knees extend together back to standing; inhale during descent.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the initial upright stance.
keyCheckpoints: Retain heel contact and controlled torso position rather than forcing a fixed depth.

mistakes.mistake: Continuing lower after heel contact or torso control is lost.
mistakes.whyItMatters: This differs from the source-described version.
mistakes.correction: Use the earlier endpoint described in the source.

setup: Support the opposite hand and knee on a stable bench, hand below shoulder and knee below hip. Hold the dumbbell in the working hand.
Brace with a flat back and head aligned with the spine; keep the shoulder down and back.
executionSteps: Exhale while drawing the upper arm backward with the elbow close to the body.
Stop before the lift requires trunk rotation or a changed spinal position.
Inhale while lowering slowly, maintaining the supported trunk position.
technique.finishOrReset: Return the weight to the hanging starting position; repeat the setup on the other side.
technique.breathing: Exhale while lifting; inhale while lowering.
keyCheckpoints: Avoid trunk rotation and loss of the stated back or shoulder position.

mistakes.mistake: Rotating the trunk to lift farther.
mistakes.whyItMatters: This differs from the source-described version.
mistakes.correction: End the lift before rotation is needed; monitor position as suggested by the source.

setup: Stand a little farther than arm length from a wall, feet shoulder width apart.
Place palms against the wall at shoulder height and shoulder width.
executionSteps: Inhale as elbows bend and the body moves slowly toward the wall, keeping feet flat.
Exhale while slowly pressing away until the arms are straight.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the initial wall-supported stance.
technique.breathing: Inhale toward the wall; exhale while pressing away.
keyCheckpoints: Keep feet flat and move slowly; use the stated wall variant.

mistakes.mistake: Using an unstable raised surface instead of the specified wall.
mistakes.whyItMatters: This differs from the source-described version.
mistakes.correction: Follow the wall-supported version; a bench variation needs separate guidance.

programmingGuidance.qualifier: Printed page 53: older-adult wall version, two sets of 10–15 with a 1-second hold. Timed rest is unspecified. Start with what can be managed; not a universal dose.

setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart behind a sturdy chair.
executionSteps: Exhale while slowly rising onto the toes as far as comfortable.
Inhale while slowly lowering the heels to the floor.
technique.finishOrReset: Return heels to the floor while retaining chair support.
keyCheckpoints: Retain the sturdy support and controlled rise and return.

mistakes.mistake: Removing the chair support or moving abruptly.
mistakes.whyItMatters: This differs from the source-described version.
mistakes.correction: Keep support available and follow the slow source sequence.

programmingGuidance.qualifier: Printed page 62: older-adult two-leg version, two sets of 10–15 with a 1-second hold. Timed rest is unspecified. One-leg progression does not inherit this set count.
